text:
emily_cs: Quick flag - PeregrineAI (dedicated trial) token + embed volume fell to ~14% overnight. Renewal ~35 days. Can somebody triage? :warning:

omar_se: Looking. Any 5xx/401/429 spikes or did they throttle batch jobs?

sam_data: Pulled quick numbers: tokens/hr baseline ~3.9k -> ~520 during drop window. 401s rose to ~6% around 03:20 UTC. No broad 5xx spike. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/nb/peregrineai/usage (internal)

val_ae: Nate (new procurement lead) started last week and kicked off a short embed POC with AtlasML; he told our AM they paused nightly ETLs for cost.

rui_onboard: Onboarding logs show several aborted warmups after an SSO key rotation at ~03:18 UTC. Could be validators caching the old key. I can push a safe resume script.

watcher_bot: [ALERT] peregrineai: sudden-usage-drop detected. Runbook: cs-triage-auth + cs-offer-cost-guard. Incident: INC-PG-20260215-9

omar_se: Running targeted synthetics to their trial endpoint. If validator caches didn't refresh we'll see 401s on signed SSO tokens.

omar_se: (after probe) 50 probes -> 46 OK, 4 401. Validator logs show signer rotated but trial validators still cached previous key id.

sam_data: SQL I used (quick slice):

```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hr, sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer = 'peregrineai'
  AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 72;
```

Drop pinned to 2026-02-15 03:20 UTC. CSV uploaded: /shared/peregrineai/2026-02-15-drop.csv

emily_cs: Proposed immediate plan:
- Omar: force validator key refresh + shorten cache TTL to 1m on trial validators. Owner: @omar_se. ETA 60m.
- Rui: send a one-page restart/runbook + safe resume script to their infra and offer a guided restart. Owner: @rui_onboard. ETA 3h.
- Val: outreach to Nate with a "cost-guard" offer (2-week credits + a custom cost dive vs AtlasML) and ask for a short QBR slot. Owner: @val_ae. ETA EOD.
- Sam: prepare hour-by-hour baseline vs drop chart for exec sync. Owner: @sam_data. ETA 2h.

emily_cs: If we don't recover to >70% baseline in 24h escalate to renewal-engage track.

omar_se: Patch applied: forced keyset refresh and lowered TTL. 401s dropped to ~0.5% in ~12 minutes. Patch log: https://infra.redwood/internal/patches/INC-PG-20260215-9 (internal)

watcher_bot: [RECOVERY] peregrineai: traffic normalized to ~82% of baseline 45 minutes after patch. INC-PG-20260215-9 resolved (auto).

emily_cs: Great work. Val please start outreach to Nate and propose the QBR. Rui confirm warmup/runbook delivery. Sam finalize the slide. Reconvene only if we see regression. :thumbsup:
